Measure around the middle of your knee and email hello@runorfit.com with the number; we will tell you which size we would send, within two business days.

A seamless stretch-knit sleeve that pulls on over the knee and stays where you put it. It applies even, gentle compression across the joint; the feeling most runners describe as the knee being "held" rather than braced. There are no straps, hinges or metal stays: this is a sleeve, not a brace.

Six sizes, and the sizing matters more here than on anything else we sell. A sleeve that is too loose rolls down; one that is too tight cuts off circulation behind the knee. Measure before you choose.

Specification

• Seamless stretch nylon knit
• Even compression, no straps or hinges
• Silicone grip band to reduce slipping
• Six sizes: S, M, L, XL, XXL, XXXL
• Four colours: Black, Blue, Grey, Red
• Choose a single sleeve or a pair

This is a sports support, not a medical device

It is not a medical device, not a prescribed orthosis and not custom fitted. We make no claim that it diagnoses, treats, cures or prevents runner's knee, arthritis, ligament injury, patellar tracking problems or any other condition, and no claim that it prevents injury.

If you have knee pain, a diagnosed knee condition, circulatory problems, diabetes, varicose veins or a blood-clotting disorder, speak to your doctor or physiotherapist before wearing compression on the leg. Stop using it if it causes numbness, tingling, swelling below the knee, colour change in the foot, or pain.

Do not wear it over broken or irritated skin, and do not sleep in it.

Delivery and returns

Free tracked shipping across Australia, with no minimum spend. Processing takes 1–3 business days and transit normally takes 6–12 business days, so most orders arrive within 7–15 business days of ordering. These are estimates, not guaranteed dates. If your order has not arrived within 30 business days of dispatch, we resend it or refund you in full, at your choice.

This is worn against the skin: we can accept a change-of-mind return only if it has not been worn. Trying it on over clothing to check the size does not count as wearing it. This does not affect your rights if it arrives faulty.

Not sure it will sit right at your waist? Email hello@runorfit.com with the measurement you need and we will tell you before you order, within two business days.

Most running belts solve one problem and create another: the pouch is big enough for a phone, so it bounces. This one is cut flat and narrow, and the strap is elastic rather than webbing, so the load sits against you instead of swinging off you.

The pocket measures 20 × 10 cm. A 6.7-inch phone lies flat inside it with room left for a key and a card; you do not have to wedge it in diagonally. Beside the main pocket there is a smaller pocket for cards and cash, a hook-and-loop flap pocket for keys, and a port on the side for a headphone cable, so your phone can stay zipped in while you listen.

Specification

• Main pocket 20 × 10 cm, zip closure, three-dimensional cut that holds its shape when loaded
• Second pocket for cards and cash, plus a hook-and-loop flap pocket for keys
• Side port for a headphone cable
• Elastic strap with side-release buckle, adjustable to approximately 70 cm total
• Reflective strip across the front
• Nylon, with moulded plastic buckle
• 85 g
• Six colours: Black, Blue, Lime, Grey, Orange, Pink
• Unisex

Good to know before you order

It is not waterproof. The fabric is woven nylon and the zip is not sealed. It shrugs off sweat and light rain; it will not keep a phone dry in a downpour.

The reflective strip is a visibility aid, not safety apparel. It lights up when a driver's headlights fall on it. It is not certified high-visibility clothing and it does not replace lights or bright clothing after dark.

products.body_html:
✓Any two items, A$20 off; add a second item and it comes off automatically at checkout
✓Free tracked delivery across Australia; every order, no minimum spend

Between the two sizes? Email hello@runorfit.com with your usual shoe size and we will tell you which pair we would send, within two business days.

A moulded EVA insole with a brushed black top cover, a raised heel cup and a cushioned pad set under the heel. The foam is perforated so air moves through it rather than sitting under your foot, and trim lines are moulded into the underside so you can cut it down to your exact size.

Specification

• Moulded EVA foam with a raised heel cup
• Cushioned pad under the heel
• Brushed top cover
• Perforated through the foam for airflow
• Trim lines moulded underneath, marked up to size 45
• Two sizes: EU 35–40 and 41–45
• Unisex · one pair per order

These are comfort insoles, not orthotics

They are not a medical device, not custom made and not prescribed. We make no claim that they diagnose, treat, cure or prevent plantar fasciitis, flat feet, overpronation or any other condition. You should be sceptical of any insole sold to you with those claims, whatever it costs.

If you have persistent foot pain, diabetes, reduced sensation in your feet or a diagnosed foot condition, talk to a podiatrist before changing what is inside your shoes.

How to fit them

Take the existing insole out of your shoe, lay it on top of the new one with the heels aligned, then cut along the trim line closest to your size. Trim in small steps; a cut cannot be undone, and an insole cut too short slides forward inside the shoe.

Use one insole per shoe. Do not stack these on top of the insole already in there: it tightens the shoe and a tight shoe causes blisters. Give yourself a few days to get used to them, and stop using them if they cause pain or rubbing.

Delivery and returns

Free tracked shipping across Australia, with no minimum spend. Processing takes 1–3 business days and transit normally takes 6–12 business days, so most orders arrive within 7–15 business days of ordering. These are estimates, not guaranteed dates. If your order has not arrived within 30 business days of dispatch, we resend it or refund you in full, at your choice.

Insoles are a hygiene item: we can accept a change-of-mind return only if they have not been worn in a shoe. Holding them against your existing insole to check the size does not count as wearing them. This does not affect your rights if they arrive faulty.
